name: רִמּוֹן
summary: Rimmon the Beerothite was the father of Baanah and Rechab, two captains in the service of Saul’s son.

evidence.note: The two captains are named as sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, of Benjamin.
David addresses Rechab and Baanah as the sons of Rimmon.

note: His name is spelled and pronounced like the common noun ‘pomegranate’. Samuel identifies him through his sons and place of origin without explaining the name.
